flags: Fixture keys are public reproducibility material, not deployment secrets.
Layouts are chosen by public hash streams, never by a detector, key or score.
The control read has the ordinary continuation of the same prompt and draw with the same flanks; its region overlap is measured against the same region.
Statistical detection only; no biological function or secret-key claim follows.
Rates above target in a control cell are reported as observed.
